maria_cs: Drafting a short, customer-facing onboarding runbook for caching/batching/streaming + renewal-risk signals. Pasting an ultra-compact checklist for CS to use on kickoff calls. Feedback welcome, keep it terse please.

devin_se: looks good, paste the one-liner we give sales too.

maria_cs: done below. also added repro template and curl snippet.

---ONBOARDING RUNBOOK (SHORT)---
Purpose: speed time-to-first-success, lower token cost, and surface early risk signals.
Quick checklist for kickoff call:
  1) Prefill & warm pools:
     - Run 2 prefills per model variant (5-20 tokens) immediately after integration.
     - If Dedicated: enable warm pool option. Hosted: schedule 2 warmup passes in first 30m.
     - Tag warmup events with `onboard:warm_v2` for tracking.
  2) Batch & concurrency:
     - Start conservatively: concurrency <=2 per instance; micro-batches of 2-4 for interactive flows.
     - Ramp to target over 72 hours while monitoring p95 latency.
  3) Streaming fallback:
     - If 95th latency > 800ms or error rate spikes, enable streaming fallback for route.
     - Client header: `X-Redwood-Fallback: true`.
     - Quick curl test:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Fallback: true" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":12}'
```
  4) Renewal & health signals:
     - Track: `prefill_success_rate`, `avg_first_response_ms`, `failed_requests_1h`.
     - If prefill_success_rate <85% after 4 tries, tag `onboard:at-risk` and notify CS.
  5) Repro template (one-liners for customers):
     - SDK/Browser: e.g., "Node 18, redwood-js@1.2.3, browser Chrome 113"
     - Sample prompt & expected tokens: paste prompt and max_tokens.
     - Network: latency to region, CDN/proxy in front?
  6) Billing & ops notes:
     - For Dedicated warmup, add telemetry tag `warmup:unbilled=true`. Finance aware.

Sales one-liner for enablement:
"Prefill warms model caches and reduces repeated token usage — customers often see lower latency and reduced token spend within minutes."

mike_support: add a PII redaction reminder: avoid sending raw user text in prefill logs; mask emails/SSNs.

lee_sre: recommend auto rollback to quantized model after 3 deploy spool failures to avoid warm pool starvation.

anya_pm: suggestion: make streaming fallback opt-out for clients that cannot consume partial results.
